subject: deal-stages
detail: A's stages are lead, qualified, proposal, won, lost (fixed); B's default stages are new, contacted, negotiating, closed (caller-supplied). Existing stage values do not match, and B's 'closed' does not say whether the deal was won or lost.
solutions: One configurable stage table seeded with A's stages; map B's values new->lead, contacted->qualified, negotiating->proposal, and keep 'closed' as an extra closed stage with outcome 'unspecified'
Seed with B's stages and map A's won and lost both to closed (loses the outcome)
Keep two separate pipelines, one per source
recommended: One configurable stage table seeded with A's five stages plus a 'closed' stage (outcome unspecified) for B's closed deals, so no stage value is lost or invented; users can reclassify those deals later

subject: deal-owner
detail: B's reminders email deal['owner_email'], but A's deals have no owner at all and neither app has users or authentication, so reminders cannot work for A's deals until an owner exists.
solutions: Add a User entity and a required Deal.owner_id; B's owner_email values become users; A's deals are assigned to an owner the user names at migration
Keep a free-text owner_email on Deal and leave A's deals without reminders
recommended: Add User and Deal.owner_id; create users from B's distinct owner_email values; assign A's existing deals to one default owner chosen by the user before migration

subject: deal-contact
detail: A's deals link to a contact; B's deals have no contact, so B's deals arrive without one.
solutions: Create a placeholder contact for B's deals
recommended: Keep Deal.contact_id nullable (it already is in A's schema); show 'no contact' in the UI

subject: reminders-on-closed-deals
detail: B's reminder job does not exclude closed deals, so after the merge won and lost deals would be emailed about forever; it also re-sends on every run.
solutions: Skip deals in stages whose outcome is won, lost or unspecified-closed, and dedupe on (deal, moved_at)
recommended: Skip closed stages and send at most one reminder per deal per idle period

subject: merge-vs-moved-at
detail: A's contact merge rewrites deals; if it touched moved_at it would reset B's staleness clock.
solutions: Merge changes only contact_id on deals
Treat a merge as a move
recommended: Merge changes only contact_id; moved_at changes only on stage moves

subject: moved-at-timezone
detail: B stores moved_at from datetime.utcnow(), a naive timestamp.
solutions: Store timezone-aware UTC; treat B's naive values as UTC on import
recommended: Store timezone-aware UTC; treat B's naive values as UTC on import
